description: JavaScript code implementing the client-side logic for the 'blame_incremental' view in gitweb, including DOM manipulation, AJAX request handling, blame data parsing, and UI updates.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Represents a blamed commit with SHA1 and related metadata.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Constructor for Commit objects, initializes SHA1 and parent count.

methods.name: countLines
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in the blame table or returns '...' if not available.

methods.name: updateProgressInfo
methods.description: Updates the progress display and progress bar width based on blamed and total lines.

methods.name: writeTimeInterval
methods.description: Displays the time taken to generate blame data and run the script.

methods.name: errorInfo
methods.description: Displays an error message within the page's progress info area.

methods.name: getColorNo
methods.description: Extracts color number from a table row's class name.

methods.name: chooseColorNoFrom
methods.description: Selects the least used color number from given options.

methods.name: findColorNo
methods.description: Determines a color number different from neighboring rows' colors.

methods.name: isStartOfGroup
methods.description: Checks if a table row is the start of a commit group.

methods.name: fixColorsAndGroups
methods.description: Recolors table rows for zebra striping and merges commit groups.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Updates a table row with blame commit info and styling.

methods.name: processBlameLines
methods.description: Parses lines of blame data and updates commit objects and UI.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes unprocessed data chunks from AJAX response.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles AJAX request errors and clears state.

methods.name: responseLoaded
methods.description: Finalizes blame data processing after AJAX completes.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles AJAX response state changes and partial data processing.

methods.name: startBlame
methods.description: Initiates the blame data retrieval via AJAX and sets up response handling.
